reviews.title: No service for five days.
reviews.body:
Have contacted customer services from cyprus phone and again email, and from South Uist, UK where the problem is, as my daughter has been without service for 5 days. One said there is no problem its your phone, the other said there is a problem, no idea when fix will come. Have today emailed John-Paul Patten, Bus Operations Manager. Lets see where it goes!
My daughter has been contacted by Lebara after this review. She has been refunded her monthly subscription and had it explained that the Vodafone is the supplier and so Lebara cannot go beyond a sincere apology as they are totally reliant on Vodafone in this case.  My daughter has accepted this but must transfer to another operator as she really needs to be connected.

reviews.title: 6 weeks/12 emails trying to get £10 refund
reviews.body:
Requested new service when previous offer finished but then told number could not be switched over to new cheaper plan. I therefore had 2 plans (1 on temporary number). Ported out to another provider and cancelled both plans. Refund was issued for 1 plan but not the other for £10. So far have sent 12 emails over 6 weeks and provided requested screenshot showing bank payments. Responses include telling me they have not heard from me, asking if issue has been resolved (when email trail makes it clear that it hasn't) and asking multiple times to send verification details.
So much effort for such small amount. Presume this must be deliberate (hoping I'll give up) or complete incompetence. I had hoped to rejoin at some point after switch to another provider but think its probably better to stay away if they can't handle a very basic request and going round in circles with what may be automated AI customer support.
reviews.author: Richard
